revenue_growth_year_one.reason: A bear reading takes the hardware surge as a cycle rather than a new run-rate. The quarter's product growth came from unit shipments and recent pricing actions, product revenue is recognized on shipment and does less for the recurring base, the third-quarter billings guidance sits below the second quarter's billings, and non-cancelable purchase commitments roughly doubled, which is exposure if hardware demand turns. If pricing actions stop being accepted while component costs and tariffs stay high, and the technology-upgrade and AI-infrastructure deployments lapse, growth falls below any fiscal year in the filed history.

terminal_growth.reason: A mature security vendor whose hardware franchise has rolled over grows with its installed base and price, below the economy's nominal rate; set below the risk-free rate with a margin, as the rule requires.
terminal_growth.history: Far below the five-year compound of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct} and below the risk-free rate of {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate.value|pct}; no filed year is anywhere near this rate, which is the point of a terminal assumption for a business ten years older and many times larger.

operating_margin_year_one.reason: Gross-margin pressure is already visible and management says both product and service gross margins may fall for the full year, from hardware component costs, memory chips, the mix shift to hardware and data-centre expansion, while research and development, sales and marketing and general and administrative expense all rise in absolute dollars. A bear year one gives back the quarter's operating leverage and lands a little under fiscal 2025's margin.

We also expect service gross margin to decline slightly for the full year 2026 as compared to 2025, primarily due to continued expansion of our data center footprint and colocation and cloud hosting capacity to support the growth in our unified SASE and SecOps offerings.
operating_margin_year_one.history: Below the trailing operating margin of {ratios.profitability.operating_margin.value|pct}, the highest in the filed history, and a little below fiscal 2025's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_margin|pct}; the quarter's gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct} is the lowest of six filled quarters against a high of {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.gross_margin.value|pct}, so the bear assumes the slide continues and the quarter's operating leverage does not repeat.

operating_margin_year_ten.quote: Service is the larger and higher-margin revenue stream, so even a slight decline there weighs on the blended margin

A bear takes the top of the range and a working-capital build against after-tax operating income that is itself lower, so the share reinvested is high.
reinvestment_rate_year_one.quote: We estimate the full year capital expenditures to be between approximately $350 million and $550 million in 2026.

terminal_growth.reason: A long-run rate for a scaled security vendor growing with its installed base, subscription renewals and price, set below the risk-free rate as the rule requires; the company's own record is of a much faster grower, and the fade to this rate over ten years is where most of the deceleration happens.
